Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. Records have been placed before this Court to consider the prayer of the appellant for suspension of his sentence and release on bail during the pendency of the appeal.

3. The appellant has been convicted vide judgment dated 14.06.2023 and sentenced vide order dated 21.06.2023 in connection with Sessions Trial No. 81 of 2021, arising out of Khaira P.S. Case No. 460 of 2020 (G.R. No. 3186/2020), passed Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.1054 of 2023(10) dt.01-12-2025 by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Jamui for the offences under Sections 376/511 and 302 of the Indian Penal Code (in short the 'IPC').

He has been ordered to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life with a fine of Rs. 5,000/- under Section 302 of the IPC and in default of payment of fine, further ordered to undergo simple imprisonment for three months and for the offences under Sections 376/511 of the IPC, he has been ordered to undergo rigorous Ganesh Pandit vs The State Of Bihar on 1 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191902870/
1 imprisonment for five years with a fine of Rs. 5,000/- and in default of payment of fine, further ordered to undergo simple imprisonment for three months.

sentences.text: Both the sentences have been ordered to run concurrently.
4. The police case was registered on the basis of a written information submitted by one Manoj Kumar Sharma (informant), who is the son of the deceased.

According to the written information,
on 26.10.2020 at about 03:00 P.M., his mother/Sonia Devi had gone to Shardari Bahiyar to bring grass for cow.

When she did not come back till 5-6 P.M., the informant began to search her and in such course, one Rama Devi of his village informed him that she had seen her mother going towards Bahiyar at about 03:00 P.M. and after some time, she had also seen accused/Ganesh Pandit going towards same direction.

Suma Devi, wife of Dinesh Pandit, also told him that Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.1054 of 2023(10) dt.01-12-2025 she saw accused/Ganesh Pandit having injury mark on his hand, oozing blood.

Thereafter, all the family members of the informant started search of their mother and found her dead- body in the field of one Arjun Pandit, having several injury marks on her body and her clothes were also torn open.
The informant, thereafter, expressed the apprehension that accused/Ganesh Pandit tried to sexually assault her mother and caused her death with sharp cut weapon.
5. We have perused the evidences available on record for a prima facie view for purpose of suspension of sentence.
6. It appears that P.W. 6 (Suma Devi) as well as P.W. 7 (Rama Devi), both have deposed that they had seen this appellant coming and going to the Bahiyar.
P.W. 6 has stated that she had seen that the finger of the appellant was injured and blood was also oozing.
P.W. 7 has stated that the deceased/Sonia Devi had gone to the Sardari Bahiyar for cutting grass, this witness had seen the appellant going to the Bahiyar at 04:00 P.M.
The appellant is her own Bhaisur.

7. We have also noticed that after the arrest of the appellant, on the basis of the disclosures made by him, the police had seized Kachiya (Hasua), which was blood stained, from the house of the appellant.
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.1054 of 2023(10) dt.01-12-2025 8.
The FSL reports are on the record.
FSL report (Exhibit P-14) opines that blood has been detected in the Exhibits, marked A, B and C.
Exhibit A is the earth mixed with grass; Exhibit B is an old dirty red check gamchi and Exhibit C is an old rusted iron Kachiya (Hasua) fitted with wooden handle.
9. In the kind of materials available on the record, we are of the opinion that the appellant would not deserve suspension of sentence and release on bail during pendency of the appeal.
10. The prayer is refused.

11. It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only prima facie and tentative for the purpose of suspension of sentence and bail only, which would not cause prejudice to either parties.
